component.name: Cornerplay
component.summary: Every game you own in one cosy library

description.p: Cornerplay gathers your games from Steam, Epic Games, GOG, Amazon Games, Battle.net and itch.io into one warm, quiet library, with a TV mode for the couch and a controller.

ul.li: Covers that keep up with the stores, the game you played last up front
A TV mode laid out like SteamOS Game Mode
Proton chosen and set up for you, with ProtonDB ratings, gamescope and performance profiles
Playtime, favourites, collections, a backlog, notes and ratings, synced between PCs
Save backups, DLC, game updates and Steam shortcuts for Game Mode
itch.io games, and retro games from your ROM folders through RetroArch
Wishlist sales, achievements for Steam and GOG, and Discord Rich Presence

description.p: Cornerplay is not affiliated with Valve, Epic Games, GOG, Amazon or Blizzard.

screenshot.caption: TV mode, for the couch and a controller

description.p: New: itch.io games, retro games through RetroArch, wishlist sales, GOG achievements, Discord Rich Presence, time to beat from IGDB, gamescope per game, and the interface in Romanian. Your keys and sign-ins are kept private, downloads are checked, and backups leave secrets out.
